name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a decision, the turnovers, and who is arriving

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Cleans not booked or overdue, double bookings, statements late, night caps close, registrations expiring.
sections.sql: select reason, home, ref, detail from v_attention order by severity, reason, home

sections.title: Turnovers, next three days
sections.sql: select depart_on as departs, home, code as departing, turnaround, next_arrive_on as "next arrival", coalesce(cleaner, case when clean_id is null then 'NOT BOOKED' else 'no cleaner' end) as cleaner from v_turnovers where depart_on between stay_today() - 1 and stay_today() + 3 order by depart_on, home

sections.title: Arrivals, next three days
sections.sql: select arrive_on as arrives, home, code, guest, guests_count as guests, nights, channel from v_stays where status = 'confirmed' and arrive_on between stay_today() and stay_today() + 3 order by arrive_on, home

sections.title: The next twelve weeks
sections.sql: select w::date as "week of", count(n.night_on) as "nights on books", round(100.0 * count(n.night_on) / nullif((select count(*) from homes where active) * 7, 0), 1) as "occupancy %" from generate_series(date_trunc('week', stay_today()), date_trunc('week', stay_today()) + interval '11 weeks', interval '1 week') w left join v_nights n on n.night_on >= w::date and n.night_on < w::date + 7 group by w order by w

name: owners
title: Owners and homes
subtitle: Twelve months per home, statements, and night caps

sections.title: Homes, last twelve months
sections.note: Our margin is the management fee plus cleaning fees, less what the cleaners were paid.
sections.sql: select home, owner, nights_let as "nights let", occupancy_pct as "occupancy %", round(rent_cents / 100.0, 2) as rent, round(owner_cents / 100.0, 2) as "owner share", round(margin_cents / 100.0, 2) as "our margin", avg_rating as rating from v_home_performance order by margin_cents desc

sections.title: Statements, last three months
sections.sql: select o.name as owner, to_char(s.period_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month, s.status, round(s.payout_cents / 100.0, 2) as payout, s.issued_on as issued, s.paid_on as paid from statements s join owners o on o.id = s.owner_id where s.period_start >= (date_trunc('month', stay_today()) - interval '3 months')::date order by s.period_start desc, o.name

sections.title: Night caps
sections.sql: select home, night_cap as cap, nights_used as used, nights_booked_ahead as "booked ahead", night_cap - nights_total as "left" from v_night_cap order by (nights_total::numeric / night_cap) desc

name: compliance
title: Compliance
subtitle: The rules in docs/compliance.md checked against the records

sections.title: To act on
sections.sql: select rule, state, home, detail from v_compliance where state <> 'clean' order by case state when 'breached' then 0 else 1 end, rule, home

sections.title: Checked and clean
sections.sql: select rule, count(*) as records from v_compliance where state = 'clean' group by rule order by rule
